_doc: globalFitSyst: systematic shapes for the global fit, written into the pre-fit file (was globalFitSyst.C). Object paths are relative to 'etaDir' of the pre-fit file; paths of external files start with a root of config/Inputs.json ({prefit}). Each block can be switched off with enabled=false. Dropped from the macro: the 2017H branch (all blocks off) and the Run2Test exception of incjetHdm (missing reference allowed); the unused clone ptchs_multijet_src0 of multijetJer.

multijetJer._modeNote: leading, recoil, or ptave (average of the two fits, placeholder for an updated JER); keep consistent with multijetMode of reprocess
multijetJer._ptRangeNote: open interval; hard-coded in the macro ('use counts later?')
multijetJer._functionsSource: fits in minitools/systMultijet.C on UL17BCDEF; flat JER SF uncertainty assumed

gamMass._errorMatrixSource: Zee mass fit, 17Nov17_V10 BCDEF (EOY2017), copied from reprocess.C / minitools/drawZmass.C
gamMass._ptFactorNote: the eigenvector functions are evaluated at 2*pT(photon), the Z pT scale

hdm._note: pure HDM variant for globalFitRun2: hdm - w1*gain1 - w6*gain6 in non-empty bins; 0.5 would match zjet, 0 matches Zll+jet

hadwFitProb._functionsSource: UL18 fitProb scans of minitools/hadW.C::DrawFP(), used for all epochs (UL17 values: ptave 0.20652, 86.857; ptboth 0, 125.54)
hadwFitProb._outputsNote: signed sources in units of 1 (scale*function, or scale*(function-minus)); written in this order

hadwFsr._fileNote: FSR variations from PS weights (only in UL16V7); a symlink to a stand-in, see README.md
hadwFsr._fsrNote: hadw_fsr = 1 + fsrScale*(up-down)/nominal, written to fsrDir; 1.0 matches zjet and gamjet better than 1.5
hadwFsr._hdmNote: HDM variant of W>qq': graph divided by hadw_fsr; the hadw_fsr uncertainty is not added (likely correlated for up and down)
hadwFsr._sysOutputsNote: (up-down)/nominal; ptboth is a clone of ptave

incjetHdm._note: TH1D version of the inclusive-jet graph for globalFitRenormPF, multiplied by the Run2Test reference hdm_cmb_mj
